task.arithmetic: Default strict Java double semantics; HotSpot tiered JIT
task.ordering: Initial then final energy, nine decimal places
task.ownership: Full JVM startup, JIT execution, output and shutdown; class compilation excluded

measurement.setup: Executable built before timing; binary, dependencies and compiler revision pinned
measurement.reset: Fresh process for every independent fork
measurement.warmup: None outside process; runtime JIT preparation included where applicable
measurement.destruction: Complete shutdown and owned output release included
measurement.cache: OS caches uncontrolled; independent process forks
